reviews.question:
With the rapid development of communication technology; e.g. smart phones, tablets and other mobile devices, some people believe that the disadvantages outweigh the advantages.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
While critics argue that the fast-paced development of smart gadgets yields more negative than positive outcomes, I am of the opposite school of thought.
                 Admittedly, the widespread use of communication technology can expose users to several potential risks, particularly online fraud and identity theft. Initially, social networking platforms by nature make it relatively easy to fake identities, leaving users more vulnerable to cyber attacks. Furthermore, there has been an increasing number of reports of online scams using hacked social media accounts or stolen personal identification numbers. However, identity theft has always been a problem that is not primarily due to the lack of security on a particular networking site or application, but rather due to users' carelessness. With proper care and attention, social network users can protect themselves from fraud by adjusting their privacy control settings and turning on two-step verification, which can greatly reduce the incidence of identity theft overall.
                 On the other hand, communication technology offers enormous advantages, particularly by facilitating long-distance communication. Smartphones and other mobile devices enable people to connect no matter where they are, allowing individuals from all corners of the globe to interact instantly through messaging applications or video calls. This is a significant improvement compared with the past, when people had limited chances to engage with others outside their immediate surroundings. This can also be clearly seen in the business sector: virtual meetings and cross-border collaboration have become the norm. Video conferencing allows participants from different time zones to join live discussions, helping reduce travel costs and speed up decision-making. This is particularly beneficial for startups and small businesses aiming to expand internationally.
                 In conclusion, the profound advantages of modern digital tools in everyday life fundamentally eclipse their potential downsides. Therefore, I am firmly of the view that the advantages of this technological development far outweigh its potential drawbacks.
reviews.overall: Bài viết Đạt. Em giữ rõ quan điểm không đồng ý và triển khai đủ rủi ro về lừa đảo, cách người dùng tự bảo vệ, rồi phát triển lợi ích giao tiếp từ xa bằng đúng ví dụ kinh doanh Cô giao. Các câu nối nguyên nhân – kết quả và ví dụ đều mạch lạc. Khi kết bài, em chỉ cần gộp hai câu đang cùng khẳng định lợi ích trội hơn thành một câu chốt gọn hơn.

reviews.question:
Some people think that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones for communication has a negative effect on young people’s reading and writing skills.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
While digital devices provide great convenience, their increasing use for communication is often believed to damage young people’s literacy. Personally, I am of the same school of thought.
                   First and foremost, the overreliance on computers and mobile phones exerts a highly negative effect on young people's reading skills. Specifically, what they read on these devices tends to consist of bite-sized snippets, which severely affects their ability to stay focused for a longer period of time. This continuous exposure leads to profound comprehension problems when it comes to longer texts. To make matters worse, constant notifications pushed to their phones from social media platforms can distract them when they try to read, which further affects their reading comprehension.
                   Furthermore, digital communication tools also have a deeply negative effect on youth's writing skills. This degradation is driven by the rise in informal language used in online interactions, characterized by the use of slang, abbreviations and emojis. For the sake of convenience in communicating, young users do not adhere strictly to grammar and punctuation rules. Moreover, they heavily rely on functions: text predictions and autocorrection on computers and smartphones, which lead them to make spelling mistakes. Consequently, such colloquial language and grammar mistakes become a permanent habit,  making them much less acceptable in more formal contexts like academic essays, business proposals, and professional correspondence.
                   In conclusion, it is evident that the growing reliance on digital devices for communication negatively impacts the reading and writing skills of the younger generation. Therefore, I completely agree with the prompt.
reviews.overall: Em bám đúng hướng đồng ý và triển khai đủ ảnh hưởng lên reading skills lẫn writing skills theo dàn ý Cô giao. Hai đoạn thân bài có chuỗi giải thích rõ, đặc biệt em nối được việc đọc các mẩu ngắn với khó tập trung và khó hiểu văn bản dài. Tuy nhiên, câu nêu quan điểm ở mở bài thiếu the trong mẫu Cô đã học. Em sửa câu này rồi tự đọc lại để giữ cách dùng mẫu quan điểm thống nhất ở mở bài và kết bài.

reviews.question:
The Internet has transformed the way information is shared and consumed, but it has also created problems that did not exist before.
What are the most serious problems associated with the Internet and what are the possible solutions?
reviews.originalEssay:
While the Internet has fundamentally revolutionized the sharing and consumption of information, it has simultaneously introduced unprecedented challenges. This essay will, accordingly, provide insights into the problems and potential solutions to this phenomenon.
                 This situation has given rise to several pressing consequences, chief among them being the fact that the proliferation of the Internet brings in its wake problems in the form of cyberbullying and manipulation. Regarding the former, social media is used to spread lies and rumors to thousands of people in an instant. Due to the invasive nature of this type of bullying, there is simply no way for the victim to escape it. Regarding the latter, there are hardly any regulations on what type of information is put on the Internet, allowing malicious people to use it to their advantage. This can be seen in the way the Trump administration won the US president election in large part by running ads on social media: Facebook.
                 To address this issue, several feasible measures can be taken. Initially, governments and organizations should mount awareness campaigns about the problem associated with using the Internet, especially cyberbullying. In this effort, celebrities who are trusted by the public,can help spread the message on their platform talking about what psychological distress a bullied person has to endure. Furthermore, although manipulation is difficult to tackle, authorities should introduce legistation to check the content of social media posts and adverts. Even though this solution is in itself a form of manipulaltion, requires goverments to decide what is illegal, and remains subjective, it is a necessary step despite concerns that it may take away the freedom of speech.
                 In conclusion, the rapid transformation of how information is shared and consumed via the Internet triggers a number of adverse effects, yet it can be mitigated through well- targeted and practical solutions. It is therefore,essential that relevant parties take concerted efforts to address each consequence with specific.
reviews.overall: Bài trả lời đủ hai phần và giữ khá sát chuỗi cyberbullying, manipulation cùng ví dụ Facebook. Tuy nhiên, đoạn giải pháp đã biến phần giới hạn của biện pháp kiểm soát nội dung thành một giải pháp dứt khoát, nên chưa đúng với ý Cô giao về tính chủ quan và nguy cơ hạn chế tự do ngôn luận. Em cũng cần soát lại chính tả, khoảng trắng sau dấu phẩy và câu kết đang dang dở trước khi nộp lại bản sửa.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that reading stories from a book is better than watching TV or playing computer games for children.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that reading storybooks offers greater benefits for children than other forms of entertainment. Personally, I am of the same school of thought. 
                     First, regarding language development, reading stories helps children enrich their language ability and absorb knowledge better. In contrast, when children watch TV shows or movies, they also learn new words, expressions, and grammar structures, but spoken language is not as diverse and complicated. Similarly, those playing video games are only asked to read a text to know what to do to win or what their next mission is. Since such text revolves around the context of the game, it do not expose gamers to as many aspects of life as stories do.
                     Second, regarding imagination, reading fictional or real-life stories allows children to have better imagination. When reading, they conjure up images of a wondrous world, a homeless person’s sufferings, or a joyous moment on their own, and this helps boost creativity. On the other hand, watching a certain TV program is a passive experience where children only observe what is happening on the screen, which is merely the product of someone else’s imagination. While computer games require interaction, gamers use different strategies and tactics in order to win, which is the fruit of experience rather than creativity.
                     In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that reading stories from a book is better than watching TV or playing computer games for children because it is better for both language development and imagination.

reviews.question:
Some people think that studying at university or college is the best way for students to prepare for their future career. Others, however, say today this is no longer true.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
While some people believe that attending university or college is the most effective preparation for a future career, others argue that this trend has changed. Personally, I am of the latter school of thought.
                Admittedly, university education is highly relevant to career preparation. Initially, universities provide students with in-depth knowledge and qualifications in many professions. For example, it is impossible to become a doctor, a teacher or a lawyer without having the relevant degree. Furthermore, university education helps learners to develop high-level skills, such as critical thinking, independent research, and structured communication. These are highly valued personal traits in many modern occupations.
                However, tertiary education is far from a universally suitable or practical pathway for every student in today’s world. Many young people struggle with abstract or theoretical knowledge, while they are talented in practical tasks. For them, vocational training is a more realistic and rewarding alternative which can help them gain hand-ons experience and enter the workforce earlier in areas such as construction, automotive repair or culinary arts. For instance,  a student with little academic interest but a passion for baking can find greater success in a culinary school than in a university lecture hall. Therefore, a one-size-fits-all approach to education can hinder rather than help, which leads to wasted time and missed opportunities.
                In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that university is no longer the best way for everyone, because a one-size-fits-all approach to education can hinder students and lead to wasted time and missed opportunities.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đúng cả hai quan điểm và giữ lập trường rõ: đại học rất hữu ích nhưng không phù hợp nhất với mọi người. Hai đoạn thân bài đi đúng dàn ý, có giải thích và ví dụ làm bánh phù hợp. Tuy nhiên, bài mới có 248 từ, chưa đạt tối thiểu 250 từ. Khi viết lại, em hãy bổ sung một câu phát triển tự nhiên và vận dụng bị động ở chỗ phù hợp, đồng thời đổi hand-ons thành hands-on.

reviews.question:
Too much emphasis is placed on going to university for academic education. People should be encouraged to do vocational training, because there is a lack of qualified tradespeople such as electricians or plumbers.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
While it is argued that society should promote vocational training over university education due to a shortage of qualified tradespeople, I am of the opposite school of thought. Personally, I believe that both university education and vocational training should be equally promoted.
              On the one hand, university education plays a critical role in building a highly skilled workforce, which is essential for key sectors of the national economy including healthcare, education, engineering, and technology. For example, qualified doctors not only improve public health but also save thousands of lives, while engineers and technicians contribute to national productivity and innovation. Therefore, without sufficient investment in higher education, countries will likely face a dearth of doctors, researchers, and policymakers, which will ultimately hinder national progress. 
              On the other hand, vocational education also deserves equal attention because not all young people are academically capable. For these individuals, vocational training serves as a more realistic and rewarding alternative as it enables them to gain hands-on experience and enter the workforce earlier in areas such as construction, automotive repair or culinary arts. If society continues to blindly encourage all students to pursue higher education, it will result in wasted resources and high youth unemployment. By contrast, promoting vocational education as a viable and respectable path will help reduce graduate unemployment and ensure that all individuals are matched with careers that suit their strengths.
              In conclusion, I firmly believe that both university education and vocational training should be equally promoted because each path plays a vital role in national development and student success.
reviews.overall: Em bám đúng hướng không ưu tiên một con đường thay cho con đường còn lại và phát triển đủ hai body theo dàn ý. Các ví dụ về bác sĩ, kỹ sư, học nghề và hướng nghiệp đều phục vụ rõ cho ý chính. Chuỗi hậu quả ở cả hai đoạn mạch lạc, còn câu kết nhắc lại quan điểm nhất quán. Em tiếp tục giữ cách chọn từ nối theo đúng quan hệ nguyên nhân, kết quả và đối lập như bài này.

reviews.question:
The government should invest more money in teaching science than other subjects for a country’s development and progress.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that governments should allocate more financial resources to teaching science than to other subjects to foster a country's development and progress. In my opinion, whether this policy is beneficial depends heavily on each country's specific circumstances.
                 On the one hand, in countries that are less technologically advanced, governments should allocate more funds for science-related subjects to enhance national productivity. With sufficient financial support, schools can equip modern laboratories and conduct regular scientific projects, which serves to motivate more students to develop an interest in science. As a result, these students have the opportunity to become competent scientists, researchers, and skilled workers in key sectors of the economy, including agriculture, manufacturing, and healthcare. This allows any developing nation to progress economically.
                  On the other hand, in more developed countries where science and technology are already strong, focusing too much on science education is unnecessary. Initially, these countries need to deal with other important social problems, such as social inequality, mental health, and a loss of cultural identity, which are issues that science alone cannot solve. Academic subjects like history, literature, or ethics help students to think deeply, understand different cultures, better appreciate their own traditions and customs. Similarly, the arts encourage emotional understanding, all of which are important for maintaining a balanced society. Furthermore, other academic areas directly support science itself ; for example, ethics guide how new technology should be used in a fair and responsible way, artistic thinking can inspire innovation in science by offering new ways to look at problems. If these areas are ignored, a country may grow quickly in terms of technology but risk becoming weak in culture and human connection.
                 In conclusion, less developed nations should focus on science to grow economically. Meanwhile, advanced countries need to fund all subjects equally to maintain a balanced society.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát lập trường có điều kiện và giữ đủ các ý chính ở hai đoạn thân bài. Chuỗi tiền đầu tư → phòng thí nghiệm, dự án → nhân lực khoa học được triển khai rõ; đoạn hai cũng giữ được hai lí do về xã hội và sự hỗ trợ cho chính khoa học. reviews.question:
Many people argue that in order to improve educational quality, high school students should be encouraged to make comments or even criticism on their teachers. Others; however, think it will lead to loss of respect and discipline in the classroom.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
People have different views on whether high school students should be allowed to comment on or criticize their teachers. While this practice can sometimes cause problems, I believe each perspective has its own valid reasons. 
         On the one hand, encouraging student feedback brings significant benefits. First, it gives teachers more chances to get to know their students . When teachers are well-informed of their students' learning needs through comments from learners, they can adapt or modify their teaching methods to meet those needs.This is a clear benefit to the progress of any student. Furthermore, feedbacks from students can prevent teachers from becoming complacent as they know that they will be evaluated regularly. This causes them to improve their teaching styles and methodologies continuously, leading to the enhancement of the teaching and learning environment as a whole.
         On the other hand, there are reasons why people worry about this practice. To begin with, some students assess their teachers based on their own feelings and preferences rather than their teachers' contributions or techniques. For example, a student might evaluate their teacher's performance as poor just because he does not like the teacher's fashion style. Moreover, the classroom can be in chaos with massive numbers of comments from learners. Since opinions vary from students to students, it becomes impossible for teachers to work out a way of teaching that satisfy all students.
         In conclusion, there is a stronger argument in favor of encouraging student comments and criticism because of the pronounced educational advantages it offers. However, this is only true provided evaluations are established in a constructive and objective manner, which allows for meaningful feedback that benefits both teachers and students alike.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát dàn ý: hai đoạn thân đều giữ đúng chuỗi ý, ví dụ và điều kiện ở kết bài. Lập luận mạch lạc, đặc biệt là đoạn giải thích phản hồi giúp giáo viên điều chỉnh cách dạy. Tuy nhiên, bài này em soát chưa kỹ hai lỗi khoảng trắng sau dấu chấm. Khi chép lại, em cũng dùng dạng chuẩn feedback, vary from student to student và satisfies để câu đúng ngữ pháp.

On the one hand, encouraging student feedback brings significant benefits. First, it gives teachers more chances to get to know their students. When teachers are well-informed of their students' learning needs through comments from learners, they can adapt or modify their teaching methods to meet those needs. This is a clear benefit to the progress of any student. Furthermore, feedback from students can prevent teachers from becoming complacent, as they know that they will be evaluated regularly. This causes them to improve their teaching styles and methodologies continuously, leading to the enhancement of the teaching and learning environment as a whole.

On the other hand, there are reasons why people worry about this practice. To begin with, some students assess their teachers based on their own feelings and preferences rather than their teachers' contributions or techniques. For example, a student might evaluate their teacher's performance as poor simply because they do not like the teacher's fashion style. Moreover, the classroom can be in chaos with massive numbers of comments from learners. Since opinions vary from student to student, it becomes impossible for teachers to work out a way of teaching that satisfies all students.

In conclusion, there is a stronger argument in favor of encouraging student comments and criticism because of the pronounced educational advantages it offers. However, this is only true provided that evaluations are conducted constructively and objectively, allowing for meaningful feedback that benefits both teachers and students alike.

reviews.question:
Schools are no longer necessary because children can get so much information available through the Internet, and they can study just as well at home.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people believe that schools are no longer necessary because children can learn everything at home using the Internet. Personally, I am of the opposite school of thought.
              On the one hand, it is true that the Internet makes educational content more accessible than ever before. Children can now find video tutorials, e-books, and interactive learning tools on virtually any subject, often free of charge. For self-motivated learners, this flexibility is a valuable supplement to their studies. However, having access to information is not the same as knowing how to learn effectively. Young learners often lack the discipline, critical thinking skills, and time-management abilities to navigate and organise information independently. Without professional guidance from trained teachers and the structure that schools provide, many students may become overwhelmed or misinformed, leading to superficial or incorrect understanding.
              On the other hand, the role of schools remains irreplaceable. One of the main purposes of school is to provide academic instruction, its significance goes far beyond merely teaching facts or theories from textbooks. Schools provide a structured learning environment where students can develop essential life skills, such as teamwork, communication, and discipline. Furthermore, schools serve as important social spaces where students compete, cooperate, face challenges, and deal with a wide range of emotions. These real-life interactions help them grow emotionally and socially, which is something that cannot be gained by studying alone at home.
              In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that traditional schools remain irreplaceable. While the Internet offers great flexibility for learning, schools provide the essential guidance and social environment that children need to grow fully.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát dàn ý, giữ rõ lập trường không đồng ý và phát triển đủ hai thân bài. Chuỗi giải thích về việc trẻ cần giáo viên cùng môi trường học có cấu trúc rõ ràng. Cô yêu cầu em sửa lỗi nối hai mệnh đề độc lập trong Body 2 rồi tự soát lại dấu câu trước khi nộp bài sau.

When children start school, teachers have more influence on their intellectual and social development than their parents.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that once children enter formal education, teachers exert a more profound influence on their intellectual and social development than their parents. I strongly believe this is generally the case, as schools provide professional expertise and a varied learning environment that families cannot fully replicate.
On the one hand, children’s intellectual development is greatly enhanced by teachers’ specialised knowledge and skills. Their professional pedagogical training leads to better guidance, where specific pedagogical methods stimulate intellectual curiosity and foster critical thinking, whereas parents lack training for the same level of guidance. Furthermore, as children progress through different education stages, their academic pursuits become more complex. As a result, families find it harder to provide assistance, whereas trained teachers can handle intricacies and guide students.
On the other hand, teachers play a pivotal role in shaping children’s interpersonal skills. Through an interactive environment, student-student and teacher-student interactions help youngsters learn cooperation and conflict resolution through shared activities. Moreover, as experienced mentors, teachers guide encounters and navigate complexities of social relationships, whereas the home cannot provide the same diversity of experiences and exposure to varied perspectives.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that teachers are generally more influential once children begin school. Their professional instruction and a diverse social setting provide contributions that parents cannot replicate fully at home.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời đúng cả hai mặt trí tuệ và xã hội, giữ được quan điểm đồng ý và các nhánh lý do chính trong dàn ý. Tuy nhiên, bài có 219 từ, còn thiếu 31 từ so với mức tối thiểu; em cần phát triển rõ hơn cách các tương tác ở trường giúp trẻ xử lý bất đồng, thay vì thêm câu lặp ý. Hai thân bài đã có từ nối sang lý do thứ hai, nhưng chỗ vào lý do đầu chưa thể hiện rõ khung triển khai đã học. Em sửa các cụm diễn đạt chưa chính xác rồi nộp lại bài đủ từ.

annotations.label: a1
annotations.title: Nối rõ đào tạo với phương pháp
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Where” thường chỉ nơi chốn hoặc tình huống, nên ở đây không cho thấy rõ việc được đào tạo giúp giáo viên dùng phương pháp nào. Câu cũng chưa báo đây là lý do đầu trong thân bài.

Initially, their professional pedagogical training enables them to use methods that stimulate intellectual curiosity and foster critical thinking. Parents, despite their best intentions, often lack the training needed to provide the same level of guidance.

anchors.quote: Their professional pedagogical training leads to better guidance, where specific pedagogical methods stimulate intellectual curiosity and foster critical thinking, whereas parents lack training for the same level of guidance.

annotations.label: a2
annotations.title: Giới thiệu và phát triển lý do đầu
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Em đã nêu đúng tương tác và kết quả, nhưng “Through an interactive environment” không chỉ rõ trường học tạo ra môi trường ấy và chưa báo đây là lý do đầu. Em có thể phát triển thêm cách trẻ thực hành xử lý bất đồng.

Initially, schools provide an interactive setting in which student-student and teacher-student interactions help youngsters learn cooperation and conflict resolution through shared activities. These repeated encounters give children opportunities to practise working with others when they disagree.

anchors.quote: Through an interactive environment, student-student and teacher-student interactions help youngsters learn cooperation and conflict resolution through shared activities.

annotations.label: a3
annotations.title: Nêu đúng người được hướng dẫn
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Guide encounters” không nói rõ giáo viên hướng dẫn ai; “teachers navigate” lại thành giáo viên tự xử lý các mối quan hệ. Theo ý em, giáo viên giúp trẻ làm việc đó.

Moreover, as experienced mentors, teachers can guide children through such encounters and help them navigate the complexities of social relationships. The home cannot usually provide the same diversity of experiences or exposure to varied perspectives.

anchors.quote: Moreover, as experienced mentors, teachers guide encounters and navigate complexities of social relationships, whereas the home cannot provide the same diversity of experiences and exposure to varied perspectives.

annotations.label: a4
annotations.title: Sửa kết hợp từ ở kết bài
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Provide contributions” là kết hợp từ chưa tự nhiên. Hãy viết hai yếu tố này giúp giáo viên đóng góp cho sự phát triển của trẻ theo cách cha mẹ khó tái tạo ở nhà.

Their professional instruction and a diverse social setting allow them to contribute to children's development in ways that parents cannot fully replicate at home.

anchors.quote: Their professional instruction and a diverse social setting provide contributions that parents cannot replicate fully at home.
